Welcome to Nivo Vault.

Before you continue, please read and agree to the following:

1. LOCAL-ONLY STORAGE
All your files are stored only on this device. Nivo Vault does not upload any file to the internet or any cloud service.

2. DATA LOSS RISK
If you uninstall the app, lose your phone, or reset the device, your files will be permanently lost. We recommend using the Export Backup feature regularly.

3. SECURITY
Nivo Vault uses a PIN and optional fingerprint to protect your data. Deleting files requires the PIN. You are responsible for remembering it.

4. NO TRACKING
We do not collect any data, statistics, or analytics. There are no ads.

5. YOUR RESPONSIBILITY
You are responsible for the files you store and how you use the app.

By tapping 'I Agree', you accept these terms.
